In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of a relativistic separable interaction model of the neutron-protron system, which can be used in the calculation of the nuclear structure and reaction properties of light nuclei.
the construction of the relativistic separable potential with inelasticities, which is a generalization of the real-valued separable potentials elaborating earlier.
the construction of the relativistic neutron-proton separable interaction kernels which can be used to describe the scattering data up to 1 GeV.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed separable interaction kernel is a good approximation to the neutron-proton interaction in a wide range of energies.
the complex separable neutron-nucleon potentials are able to describe the elastic and inelastic parts of the $NN$ interaction.
a good description of the elastic and inelastic neutron-proton scattering data in the whole range of energies up to 3~GeV is obtained with a single separable kernel.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed relativistic separable neutron-propton interaction kernel is suitable for the description of the elastic and inelastic parts of the scattering.
the relativistic separable neutron-protron interaction kernel with inelasticity is elaborated and its application to the description of the elastic neutron-protron scattering is presented.
the proposed separable potentials can describe the elastic and inelastic parts of the scattering simultaneously.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the relativistic separable interaction kernels can be applied to describe the elastic and inelastic parts of the scattering simultaneously.
the relativistic separable interaction kernels of the neutron-protron system with the inelasticity are proposed and their parameters are obtained.
the relativistic complex potentials with the imaginary part can be used in the relativistic calculations of the elastic and inelastic neutron-proton scattering processes.
